Class BooDataResult

java.lang.Object
org.example.BooDataResult
public class BooDataResult extends Object
Represents the result data structure for Bill of Operations (BOO) calculations.

This class holds data about operations and item quantities, organizing them in a structured way for further processing or reporting.
